fields.help: Item field holding the local image path. Defaults to image_path, path, file_path, or media_path (first non-empty).
fields.label: Image Path Field

fields.help: Left edge of the crop region. Requires y, width, and height.
fields.label: Crop X (px)

fields.help: Top edge of the crop region. Requires x, width, and height.
fields.label: Crop Y (px)

fields.help: Width of the crop region (explicit region mode).
fields.label: Crop Width (px)

fields.help: Height of the crop region (explicit region mode).
fields.label: Crop Height (px)

fields.help: Crop to this aspect ratio instead of an explicit region. Provide either (x, y, width, height) or aspect_ratio.
fields.label: Aspect Ratio

fields.help: Which part of the image to keep when cropping by aspect ratio.
fields.label: Anchor

fields.help: Item field where the output file path is written.
fields.label: Output Field

fields.help: Directory for the cropped file. Defaults to the source image's directory. ~ is expanded.
fields.label: Output Directory
